title: Freelancer Workspace — guide
overview: A modular workspace for independent work. Opportunities is available; Finances and AI site creation are future modules.
usage: Sign in and start in New York Flatiron / NoMad. Use a district shortcut for the US, Canada, Ireland or the Netherlands; the map pans and clears stale results without issuing a paid search. Then search explicitly. You can still edit the circle center and radius. Prepare a contact message in English (default) or Brazilian Portuguese independently of the workspace locale. Portfolio is optional; empty values omit its paragraph. Enable the preview option only when you already have a preview, and provide its HTTPS URL. Changes to language, portfolio or preview refresh the editable draft. Opening WhatsApp never records contact automatically.
eligibility: A busca exige telefone, WhatsApp ou e-mail informado. Escolha sem site, com site ou todos; os links de sites existentes ficam visíveis. O Google não retorna e-mail nem WhatsApp verificado, e esses dados nunca são inferidos. Os resultados não são exaustivos.
architecture: The browser calls authenticated Next.js Experience routes. A process-api repository adapter forwards the verified session to the Fastify Process API. Domain usecases enforce eligibility; repository adapters isolate memory or Firestore persistence. Firebase SDKs are isolated inside infrastructure. PlaceCategory validates the shared core catalog in SearchOpportunities before provider calls. CategorySelect adapts the catalog and CMS labels for the screen. Existing factories, ports and provider/usecase shift keys are reused. No new mutation or queue behavior is introduced.
domains: Opportunity searches use a validated Region value object. Contact state transitions from not-contacted version 0 to contacted version 1. Firebase identity owns each contact record. Contact commands require an expected version and UUID idempotency key. The same command replays its result; conflicting payloads or versions return 409. External provider calls do not occur inside database transactions. Contact-state versions also advance on a new manual WhatsApp confirmation; contact registration uses the current shared version and preserves that confirmation.
content: English and Brazilian Portuguese UI copy is stored in apps/docs/content/<locale>/workspace.json, accessed through GetContent and the CMS port. Theme tokens come from .stitch/DESIGN.md; separate components live in packages/design-system.
api: POST /api/opportunities/search → POST /v1/opportunities/search; GET /api/opportunities/:id → GET /v1/opportunities/:id; POST /api/contacts → POST /v1/contacts. JSON bodies are validated with Zod. /api/auth/session and /api/auth/logout establish or clear HttpOnly sessions with same-origin checks. GET /api/health is public and contains no user data. Process Swagger: http://localhost:3011/docs; contract: /docs/json. POST /api/site-requests → POST /v1/site-requests accepts {companyId, language: en|pt-BR, brief: up to 2000 characters, idempotencyKey: UUID}, returns 202 with the pending record. GET /api/site-requests/:id → GET /v1/site-requests/:id returns the owner’s record or null (200). Mutations check same origin and verified sessions; Process API authenticates both routes. The category enum on POST /api/opportunities/search and POST /v1/opportunities/search now accepts all or any reviewed Table A identifier, including medical_clinic, veterinary_care, grocery_store and beauty_salon. Unsupported response-only values such as health return 400. OpenAPI lists the complete enum; no route or authentication change is introduced. POST /api/whatsapp-confirmations → POST /v1/whatsapp-confirmations accepts companyId, phone, expectedVersion and UUID idempotencyKey; returns ContactState with optional whatsappConfirmation. Confirmation increments the shared contact-state version without marking contacted.
configuration: Normal development/production defaults: infra.auth.provider=firebase-auth, API infra.repositories.provider=firestore (Next.js keeps process-api), infra.places.provider=google-places, infra.maps.provider=google, infra.queue.provider=firestore-pending and infra.cms.provider=json. Existing domain usecase shifts stay default. APP_ENV=test explicitly selects local auth, demo places, schematic maps, memory contacts and SQLite pending requests. Playwright uses ports 3100/3111/3102 and app.buildDirectory=.next-test, isolated from live ports 3000/3011/3002 and normal .next output. RuntimeFactory resolves the output directory through ConfigManager; unknown values fail validation. Secrets stay in environment references. No theme/design-system changes. domains.opportunities.usecases.confirmWhatsapp=default. infra.auth.publicOrigin sets the exact trusted browser origin; empty uses the request URL. Production web uses its App Hosting HTTPS origin. domains.audits.usecases.analyze=deferred keeps the LLM disconnected; default remains available with fixtures for tests.
setup: Firebase project freela-c8c75 has enabled billing, initialized Auth, an enabled Google provider and authorized localhost/127.0.0.1 domains. The default Firestore database is Standard Native in us-central1 with deny-all browser rules. Restricted Maps/Places keys and local Application Default Credentials are configured and verified. The normal app uses real cloud services; public production App Hosting/Functions, managed runtime identities, secrets, App Check and WIF/CI remain pending. See deploy/SETUP.md.
privacy: Only place identifiers and user-entered contact state/history, site-request language and brief are persisted for live Google results; returned company details are not stored in Firestore. Do not put personal contact notes into logs. Local authentication, in-memory contacts and local SQLite queue refuse production startup. Local ADC and Places keys stay server-side. App Check and deployment access protection remain required before public hosting.
validation: Run pnpm ci:quality and pnpm changelog. Coverage reports are generated per app and the changed-file gate requires 90% in every metric. Queue adapter contracts test replay, owner separation, persistence, duplicates and conflicts. Firestore emulator tests cover concurrent queue submissions and deny-all browser access. Playwright covers international jumps, independent message language, optional URLs and persisted pending requests; Storybook includes preset states and queue states. Local servers: web 3000, API/Swagger 3011, docs 3002, Storybook 6006. There is no running AI listener in this request-capture stage.
verification: Live Google sign-in created a session and opened the authenticated workspace and company details successfully (HTTP 200). A real Places pipeline fetched 20 places and found 10 without listed websites around New York; all records were real. Google Maps browser loading succeeded without auth/runtime errors. Firestore read and a temporary write/transaction/cleanup succeeded. Automated suites use fixtures/emulators, not live credentials. See docs/live-services.md for detailed validation and remaining production deployment work.
deployment: Production web and Process API deploy independently to Firebase App Hosting and second-generation Functions in us-central1. GitHub main workflows run all quality gates before OIDC/WIF deployments, stamp the validated commit, and verify uncached health responses. Runtime identities are separate from deploy identities; Places stays server-only in Secret Manager. The production domain is authorized for Google login and Maps. Private docs and Storybook remain local until access policy is decided. No AI generator is dispatched.
international: Eight editable search starting points: New York Flatiron / NoMad, Austin South Congress, Toronto Queen West, Vancouver Mount Pleasant, Dublin Creative Quarter, Cork Oliver Plunkett Street, Amsterdam De Pijp and Rotterdam Witte de With. Approximate centers and 1–1.5 km radii target commercial areas documented by official district/tourism guides. These are prospecting suggestions, not evidence that businesses lack websites or will buy. Source links are available beside the selected district; the catalog and citations are documented in docs/international-prospecting.md. Country selection does not determine payment currency; agree USD or another currency with each client. The finance module remains deferred.
siteRequests: In Prepare contact, use Queue website request, optionally add a brief, and choose the intended language. The saved request remains pending, including after reopening the drawer or restarting the local API. Each authenticated user owns their backlog. This is only request capture, explicitly requested without the AI backend: there is no generator, worker, automatic publishing, task dispatch or claim that a site was created. Requesting a site does not record contact and does not enable the already-have-preview option.
siteRequestArchitecture: Sites domain: RequestSite and GetSiteRequest usecases, SiteRequestQueuePort and SitesFactory in Process API. The authenticated Experience API forwards through its SitesPort/process-api adapter and own usecases/factory. Contract schemaVersion=1 contains companyId, language, user-entered brief, status=pending, version=0, createdAt and deterministic request ID; it stores no returned Google business details. The normal runtime uses Firestore request-scoped transactions; explicit test-only SQLite opens/closes a connection per operation and uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE. One pending request per owner/company; exact retries replay their result, equivalent new keys deduplicate, conflicting payloads or key reuse return 409. No side effects occur in transaction callbacks. A future AI implementation must add a separate Cloud Tasks listener with bounded retries and failed-job recovery before dispatch is enabled.
categories: The category selector now exposes all 478 direct Nearby Search filter types from Google’s official Table A, reviewed November 16, 2026. Its first group highlights 31 prospecting suggestions: medical/dental/veterinary clinics, groceries/convenience stores/supermarkets, beauty and hair/nail salons, physiotherapy, fitness, food, trades and professional services. All other types remain grouped by Google taxonomy. Search localized names or original provider IDs; translated labels never alter request identifiers. The catalog is a local reviewed snapshot, not a live dynamic download. Table B response-only types are excluded. These suggestions are product heuristics rather than guaranteed buying intent; Google has no direct filter for small/medium business size.
mapInteraction: The map sits above its controls. Drag the basemap or click a point to preview a circle centered there. Its circle is passive and cannot capture mouse drags. Latitude/longitude edits move the map immediately; radius edits preserve draft coordinates. Apply confirms the draft, Cancel restores the previous region, and Search remains explicit. A normal wheel scrolls the page; Google Maps uses Ctrl+wheel for zoom on desktop. Invalid drafts are not forwarded to the loaded map.
layout: The workspace uses ordinary document scrolling with a visible scrollbar. Map and sidebar stay available on sufficiently tall desktop screens; the map stops sticking on short screens so its controls remain reachable. On mobile the map appears before the results. Controls use 36px targets, compact card padding and shorter map height, all through the existing Tailwind theme. Dialog headings/actions do not create duplicate page landmarks.
deploymentVerification: The public login page rendered without runtime errors and opened the Google OAuth provider. Anonymous business requests were rejected with 401. International shortcuts are disabled until hydration connects their selection handlers. Health checks verify the exact served SHA with bounded propagation retries.
websiteAnalysis: Abra os detalhes/contato de uma empresa com site e solicite a análise do HTML com IA. Revise observações, sugestões e evidências antes de incluir até três melhorias traduzidas na proposta editável. O relatório acompanha o idioma do aplicativo; a língua da proposta é independente. Portfólio e prévia continuam opcionais. O relatório não é salvo e nada é enviado automaticamente.
auditArchitecture: Audits domain: AnalyzeWebsite, WebsiteReaderPort and WebsiteAnalyzerPort in Process API; HTTP public-address-pinned reader and Vertex Gemini analyzer behind ConfigManager/AuditsFactory. Experience repository forwards authenticated requests. New routes POST /api/website-audits and POST /v1/website-audits accept only companyId. Live selectors infra.ai.provider=vertex, infra.websites.provider=http; test selectors fixture are forbidden in production. Read timeout 15000ms, model 45000ms, Experience 90000ms, Functions 120s. Model gemini-3.8-flash uses ADC; no stored audit, background queue or automatic retries. Contact history and site-request transactions remain unchanged.
firebaseTransport: O adaptador de Firebase Functions reproduz os bytes originais da requisição, já consumidos pela plataforma, no ciclo completo do Fastify. Autenticação, limites do corpo JSON, validação e idempotência continuam ativos. Um teste HTTP de regressão e uma verificação de JSON no deploy previnem travamentos silenciosos em requisições POST.
whatsappConfirmation: Abrir WhatsApp tenta o telefone informado e mantém a etiqueta de não confirmado. Confira o número lá, volte e clique em Confirmar WhatsApp para salvá-lo na sua conta. Abrir não confirma nem registra contato. A confirmação permanece após recarregar; um telefone alterado precisa ser confirmado novamente.
productionLogin: O login em produção valida a origem HTTPS pública configurada atrás do App Hosting. O acesso com Google então cria uma sessão protegida no servidor.
storage: Os resultados ficam na memória da tela. O Firestore salva identificadores das empresas, seu histórico de contato, confirmações manuais de WhatsApp e pedidos de site; uma lista de prospecção salva ainda não foi implementada.
auditAvailability: Somente preparado: domains.audits.usecases.analyze=deferred na API de processo. A implementação Vertex preparada anteriormente não é chamada até ser conectada explicitamente.
navigation: Use Buscar oportunidades junto aos filtros ou Buscar nesta região abaixo do mapa. O campo textual de busca de categorias foi removido; o catálogo agrupado continua completo. Cada resultado tem apenas Preparar contato. Os resultados e marcadores do mapa abrem o mesmo formulário, com os dados da empresa.
